summary: Aluminum hex wheel adapter, 17 mm long and 12 mm across flats. The hex axis runs along z. One end has a 3 mm shaft bore and the opposite end has a blind M4 hole for the wheel screw. Two M3 radial holes on one hex flat open into the shaft bore.

mountingSurfaces.description: End face with the 3 mm shaft bore, which sits on the motor shaft side
End face with the M4 hole for the wheel retaining screw, on the wheel side
Hex flat carrying the two M3 set-screw holes, spaced 4.5 mm apart, with the first 2.75 mm from the shaft-bore end
Opposite hex flat. The 12 mm hex drives a wheel with a matching hex hub.

notes: The drawing prints 17 mm length, 12 mm across flats (end view), a 3 mm bore diameter, 2.75 mm and 4.5 mm set-screw spacing, and a 7 mm M4 hole depth. The x extent of 13.86 mm is across corners, computed from 12 / cos(30°); it is not printed. The end view shows flats at top and bottom, so the set-screw flat is placed at +y. The 3 mm bore depth is not printed, and the drawing does not show whether it meets the M4 hole. The M3 hole diameter uses the nominal 3 mm and is not a drilled size from the drawing. The two M3 holes are placed along the axis from the shaft-bore end, at z = 5.75 and 1.25 with the part centered. The 4 mm hole diameter is nominal.
